Subject: Steering brief — CTO slot nomination and compact VP fallback

Hi Eve —

Thanks again for taking time to speak with Paul and me last week. We'd like to set up a short executive steering brief to walk through a focused demo of the inference routing and failover flow that maps to your production constraints. High-level ask: secure CTO attendance for a compact briefing (30 minutes preferred, 45 minutes possible) and nominate a VP-level fallback in case of last-minute conflicts.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 20: 09:00–09:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed Jul 21: 13:30–14:00 (tight 30-min) or 14:00–14:45
- Thu Jul 22: 09:00–09:30 (30-min)

If the CTO can only do a shorter window, we can compress to a strict 30-minute run: agenda is demo (10), configuration implications (10), Q&A/next steps (10). Ben Carter (solutions engineer) will stand by for technical Qs; Marissa Cole can act as the VP-level business owner if needed.

Attached is a one-page agenda and a suggested pre-read link; happy to shorten. Could you confirm CTO availability for any of the slots above and whether Paul or Daniel should be invited directly?

Appreciate it — I'll hold the tentative time on our side for the most likely slot you flag.

[Attachment: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf (1.1 MB)]
[Pre-read: https://drive.redwood/demo-deck-v2.pdf]

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear options and the agenda — helpful. Quick heads-up on internal availability: our CTO (Daniel Kramer) has a pretty locked calendar next week but can free a strict 30-minute slot on Wed Jul 21 at 14:00 PT. There's a second option on Thu Jul 22 at 09:00 PT for 30 minutes, but Daniel prefers the 21st.

For the VP fallback, our VP of Engineering (Aisha Malik) is likely available but prefers to be kept as the backup rather than the first invite. Can you send options with the CTO as primary invite and Aisha as optional (or CC) so we can avoid double-booking?

Also, please keep the demo to the compact agenda you outlined and include a 1–2 slide pre-read that calls out latency & failover behavior — that'll help Daniel focus the Qs.

Appreciate it — if you send an invite for 21 Jul 14:00 PT I'll confirm on our side.

— Eve
